# eBay Australia

> eBay Australia is a diverse online marketplace offering electronics, cars, fashion, collectibles and more with membership benefits, daily deals, and secure account management.

eBay Australia serves as a regional hub for the global eBay marketplace, featuring localized content, Australian sellers and buyers, and region-specific deals. The platform emphasizes account security, user authentication, and fraud prevention across all user interactions.

## Key Topics

- eBay Australia
- My eBay
- eBay Plus
- Account Security
- Identity Verification
- User Authentication
- Marketplace Homepage
- Electronics
- Fashion
- Collectibles
- Daily Deals

## Core Marketplace

- [eBay Australia Homepage](https://www.ebay.com.au): eBay Australia main marketplace homepage with electronics, cars, fashion & collectibles
- [Daily Deals](https://www.ebay.com.au/deals): eBay daily deals page with discounted electronics and free shipping
- [eBay Plus Membership](https://www.ebay.com.au/vlp/ebayplus): eBay Plus membership program with exclusive deals and free delivery

## Account & Authentication

- [Sign In or Register](https://signin.ebay.com.au/ws/eBayISAPI.dll): eBay Australia login and registration page with social login options
- [Security Verification](https://signup.ebay.com.au/pa/crte): eBay account security verification and identity verification page
- [Account Preferences](https://www.ebay.com.au/d/myebay/preferences): My eBay account preferences and settings page

## My eBay Dashboard

- [My eBay Home](https://www.ebay.com.au/mys/home): My eBay account home page with security verification
- [My eBay Summary](https://www.ebay.com.au/mye/myebay/summary): My eBay summary page with account overview and activity
- [Purchase History](https://www.ebay.com.au/mye/myebay/purchase): My eBay purchase history and order tracking page
- [Watchlist](https://www.ebay.com.au/mye/myebay/watchlist): My eBay watchlist page for tracking saved items
- [Bids & Offers](https://www.ebay.com.au/mye/myebay/bidsoffers): My eBay bids and offers tracking page
- [Feedback & Ratings](https://www.ebay.com.au/mye/myebay/rvi): My eBay received feedback and ratings page

## Saved Items & Preferences

- [Saved Items](https://www.ebay.com.au/mye/myebay/saved): My eBay saved items and collections page
- [Saved Searches](https://www.ebay.com.au/mye/myebay/savedsearches): My eBay saved searches management page
- [Saved Sellers](https://www.ebay.com.au/mye/myebay/savedsellers): My eBay saved sellers and favorites page

## Communication & Support

- [Messages Inbox](https://mesg.ebay.com.au/mesgweb/ViewMessages/0): eBay Messages inbox for user communications
- [Help & Support](https://www.ebay.com.au/help/home): eBay Australia help and support documentation homepage
